name: hints
label: Hints
description: Launcher gate. Reads a draft intent and proposes ready-to-open new sessions across every configured project — an agent, its folder, and a short opening message staged into the composer for editing. Past sessions are research, not the destination.

inputs.name: query
inputs.label: Your intent
inputs.placeholder: what do you want to do?

agents.description: The agent catalog: every openable (project, folder, agent profile) triple, with the profile's description and how many sessions have actually used it. This is where a recommendation's `target` comes from — the project and folder are attached to it automatically, so never write a folder path by hand.

query.description: Filter by words appearing in the agent key, project name, or description

search.description: Full-text search across sessions in EVERY configured project. Research: it tells you which project a draft belongs to and what recently happened, so you can write a grounded opening message and cite real sessions in `references`.

project.description: Restrict to one project id from the agents op

role.description: Search only user messages or only assistant messages

sinceDays.description: Only sessions active within this many days. Use it when the draft says 'recently'.

read.description: Read recent turns from a past session so a reason can name what actually happened and the opening message can reference real material.

sessionId.description: Session id from search or the pre-fetched list

schemaHint: { recommendations: Array<{ kind: 'new'|'session'|'move', target: string, label: string, reason: string, prompt?: string, references?: string[], confidence?: number }>, passthrough: boolean, note?: string } — kind 'new' opens a new session; target is an agent from the catalog and its project/cwd are filled in automatically.
